title: Full self-attention inefficient for very long sequences
description: The standard self-attention mechanism attends to all positions, which becomes computationally expensive for very long sequences. The authors propose investigating local, restricted attention as a remedy.
canonical_description: full self-attention computationally prohibitive for very long sequences motivating local or restricted attention mechanisms

evidence.quote: To improve computational performance for tasks involving very long sequences, self-attention could be restricted to considering only a neighborhood of size r in the input sequence centered around the respective output position. ... We plan to investigate this approach further in future work.
